heading: How a TradingView alert reaches your broker in 4 steps

steps.title: Strategy fires an alert
steps.body: Your TradingView strategy triggers on a confirmed setup (e.g. EUR/USD crosses the 50 EMA) and emits an alert with the order payload.

steps.title: Webhook posts to SignalBots
steps.body: TradingView sends the alert as a JSON webhook to your unique SignalBots endpoint, authenticated by a secret key.

steps.title: Risk filter validates the order
steps.body: SignalBots checks lot size, max open positions and daily-loss limits, rejecting anything outside your rules before it ever leaves.

steps.title: Order lands at your broker
steps.body: The validated order routes to your MT4/MT5 account in under 10 ms and a fill confirmation returns to your dashboard.
